description: This file contains the implementation of MemoryStreamBufferWriter, a struct that implements IBufferWriter<byte> to write data to a MemoryStream, managing buffer capacity and position.

classes.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
classes.description: A struct implementing IBufferWriter<byte> that writes to a MemoryStream, managing buffer size and position.

methods.name: MemoryStreamBufferWriter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the buffer writer with a MemoryStream instance.

methods.name: Advance
methods.description: Advances the current position in the stream by the specified count.

methods.name: GetMemory
methods.description: Returns a Memory<byte> segment of the underlying stream buffer, resizing if necessary.

methods.name: GetSpan
methods.description: Returns a Span<byte> of the underlying stream buffer, resizing if necessary.
